notes: Rebuilt on tinyjs 0.59.0. On Windows with monitors at different scaling (say a 125% laptop beside a 100% monitor), the rack and its satellite windows now land, dock and restore where they should; satellites keep their size when dragged between those monitors; and amp no longer crashes on quit.

linux.notes: Built on the tinyjs 0.57 runtime. This release rebuilds the Magnetosphere visualizer, which needs WebGPU; Linux's WebKitGTK doesn't have WebGPU yet, so Magnetosphere stays hidden here and the other visualizers are unchanged.
